pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pLarger automatically constructed greenhouse with 45 growing positions and four irrigation corners.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Clear the full roof and foundation bounds.$p2. Supply the four construction materials in order and use Build.$p3. Plant compatible seeds, including Prunae, and manage CO₂ with a lantern.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pFiddledew still needs Flawless tier. An enlarged greenhouse does not bypass protection or ordinary crop survival rules.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/advanced_greenhouse)Construction plans and layers$()
